description: Exercise #59 cooperating against a fire too large for one stream. Initially involved area pi*1.35^2 is about 5.73 m2 before fuel clipping; each stream removes 1295 kW and the measured area decides the actual assessment. Evidence is both robots assessing the same gate-frame fire patch as needing two streams, aiming their spray orders at it, and overlapping positive flows in water.jsonl. Cooperation remains the agents choice.
duration_s_reason: Test observation window; also the existing recorder operating deadline. Meeting and heat re-entry require their full physical waiting periods.

fire.head_start_s_reason: Fire age when robots reach the launch pads. Zero for delayed ignition, 6 s to develop a local flame, 60 s for a heated compartment.
fire.config_file_reason: World-only fuel ignition experiment. Heat and smoke load the same file.
